content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization or missing-information issue; prior authorization is not required, and no claim-data error is identified. A formal appeal can use the clinical documentation to argue for medically necessary, separately payable monitoring and request review of the bundling determination. This progresses the existing denial without an unchanged resubmission or improperly transferring the denied balance to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
